## Clean Data

```{r}
# library(duckdb, quietly = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(haven)
library(labelled)

# Load main dataset and ACS data
main <- read_dta("data/working.dta")
acs <- read_dta("data/T16_acs.dta")

names(main)
names(acs)
# Keep only cohort3 == 1
main1 <- main %>% 
  filter(cohort3 == 1) %>%
  left_join(acs, by = "studyid") %>%
  mutate(pctnobroadband = 100 - pctbroadband_18)
```

```{r, class.output="scroll-100"}
main1
```

## Descriptive Statistics

```{r}
main2 <- main1 %>%
  mutate(across(ep_pov_18:pctnohealthins_18, ~as.numeric(.))) %>%
  mutate(across(ep_pov_18:pctnohealthins_18, ~na_if(., . < 0))) %>%
  arrange(studyid, visitdate) %>%
  group_by(studyid) %>%
  mutate(visitno = row_number())
```

```{r, class.output="scroll-100"}
main2
```

## Age

```{r}
main3 <- main2 %>%
  group_by(studyid) %>%
  mutate(index_date = min(visitdate)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(censor_date = index_date + lubridate::years(2),
         censor_visit = visitdate > censor_date) %>%
  # Cohort4: at least 4 visits, not censored
  group_by(studyid) %>%
  mutate(tlvisitno = n(),
         cohort4 = if_else(min(censor_visit == FALSE) & 
                             tlvisitno >= 4, 1, 0)) %>%
  filter(cohort4 == 1) %>%
  mutate(agecat = case_when(
    age >= 52 & age < 65 ~ 1,
    age >= 65 & age < 74 ~ 2,
    age >= 74 ~ 3,
    TRUE ~ 0
  ))

main3$agecat <- factor(main3$agecat, 
                       labels = c("25-56", 
                                  "56-70", 
                                  "70-79", 
                                  "79-125"))
```

```{r, class.output="scroll-100"}
main3
```

## Subset

```{r}
main4 <- main3 %>%
  group_by(studyid) %>%
  mutate(index_date = min(visitdate)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(censor_date = index_date + lubridate::years(2),
         censor_visit = visitdate > censor_date) %>%
  group_by(studyid) %>%
  mutate(tlvisitno = n(),
         cohort4 = if_else(min(censor_visit == FALSE) & 
                             tlvisitno >= 4, 1, 0)) %>%
  filter(cohort4 == 1)
```

```{r, class.output="scroll-100"}
main4
```

## Follow-up and Progress

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
main5 <- main4 %>%
  group_by(studyid) %>%
  arrange(visitdate) %>%
  mutate(visitno = row_number(),
    fu_m = as.numeric(visitdate - first(visitdate)) / 30.5,
    int_d = as.numeric(visitdate - lag(visitdate)),
    ave_int = median(int_d, na.rm = TRUE),
    fu_end = max(fu_m, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(studyid) %>%
  arrange(visitdate) %>%
  mutate(d_proc = num_proc - lag(num_proc),
         d_proc_cat = case_when(
           d_proc > 0 ~ "increase",
           d_proc < 0 ~ "decrease",
           d_proc == 0 ~ "no change",
           TRUE ~ NA_character_),
         ever_increase = max(d_proc > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
         d_num_meds = num_ded_meds - lag(num_ded_meds),
         d_num_meds = if_else(d_num_meds == 0 & 
                                (ded_meds1 - lag(ded_meds1)) 
                              != 0, 1, d_num_meds),
         d_med_cat = case_when(
           d_num_meds > 0 ~ "increase",
           d_num_meds < 0 ~ "decrease",
           TRUE ~ "no change"),
         any_progress = if_else(ever_increase | 
                                  d_med_cat != "no change",
                                1, 0)) %>%
  ungroup()

```

## Merging Time

```{r}
main6 <- main5 %>%
  mutate(tp = case_when(
    fu_m > 0 & fu_m < 6 ~ 1,
    fu_m >= 6 & fu_m < 12 ~ 2,
    fu_m >= 12 & fu_m < 18 ~ 3,
    fu_m >= 18 ~ 4,
    TRUE ~ 0))
```

## Model fitting

```{r}
library(survey)

# Basic cluster-adjusted logistic regression using survey package
main6$cluster_id <- main6$studyid
design <- svydesign(ids = ~cluster_id, data = main6)
names(main6)
main6 <- main6 %>%
  filter(!is.na(any_progress) &
         !is.na(agecat) &
         !is.na(female) &
         !is.na(yr2017) &
         !is.na(insurcat2_bl) &
         !is.na(ethnic_cat) &
         !is.na(race_cat2) &
         !is.na(lang_cat) &
         !is.na(change_coverage) &
         !is.na(relocate))

# Example: Any Progress ~ Age, Female, Race, etc.
model0 <- svyglm(any_progress ~ factor(agecat) + female + yr2017 +
                   factor(insurcat2_bl) + factor(ethnic_cat) +
                   factor(race_cat2) + factor(lang_cat) +
                   change_coverage + relocate,
                 design = design,
                 family = binomial())


# Example: Any Progress ~ Age, Female, Race, etc.
model1 <- svyglm(any_progress ~ factor(agecat) + female + yr2017 +
                   factor(insurcat2_bl) + factor(ethnic_cat) +
                   factor(race_cat2) + factor(lang_cat) +
                   change_coverage + relocate,
                 design = design,
                 family = quasibinomial())

summary(model0)
summary(model1)
```
